notes: 45 commits, 2021-09-23 to 2021-10-31; English base is the d2l-en snapshot imported in commit 5d9e696 (README: v0.17.0). Russian prose covers the first ~68 paragraphs of chapter_introduction/index.md (through the Classification and Tagging subsections), the math-appendix and linear-networks index pages, the opening paragraph of linear-regression.md, README.md and the book title; everything else is English. Introduction and appendix index: machine-translation draft post-edited by hand (markup and URL spacing artifacts, decimal commas inside LaTeX, alongside human typos, paragraph splits and localized examples), so evidence from them stays proposed. Linear-networks index and linear-regression opening (Denis Abrashin, PR #1): free human translation, used for verified_d2l. See notes/ru-d2l-ru-stabuev.md.
